title: Nourishing Canadian Cheese Lasagna
description: A hearty, pungent, and cheesy lasagna dish originating from Canada, featuring the unique pairing of tomato ketchup with a rich bechamel sauce. This recipe is perfect for a comforting dinner or a gathering with friends.
instructions: Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions.  Drain and set aside.
In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over low heat.
Whisk in the flour and cook for 1-2 minutes, forming a roux.
Slowly add the milk, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until thickened, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in the grated cheddar, mozzarella, and Parmesan cheese until melted and smooth.
Add the ricotta cheese, salt, pepper, nutmeg, and garlic to the bechamel sauce. Mix well to combine.
In a large skillet, sauté the chopped onion and garlic in butter until softened.
Stir in the tomato ketchup and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Combine the cooked lasagna noodles, bechamel sauce, and tomato ketchup mixture in a large bowl. Mix well to combine.
Transfer the lasagna mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish and smooth the top.
Sprinkle additional grated mozzarella cheese on top, if desired.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
